admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Manage users, access, appearance and system configuration.
admin.empty: No admin tools are available to your account.

landing.hero_subtitle: Every feature is a self-contained module with its own routes, migrations, permissions and Inertia views. Drop one in, and the host wires it up on boot.

features.module_system_description: Drop a package into modules/ and its URLs, migrations and menu entries register themselves.
features.auth_description: Email and cookie sessions, invites, password reset and optional Keycloak SSO out of the box.
features.schema_description: Each module declares its models, routes and permissions in one place; the host reads that declaration on boot.
features.inertia_description: React pages served straight from Python views. No separate API layer to keep in sync.
features.diagnostics_description: Every module can register health checks; make doctor and the Doctor screen report on all of them.
features.devtools_description: make new-module scaffolds a working module, complete with tests and a page shell.

landing.how_it_works_heading: One process · many modules · zero glue.
landing.quickstart_body_suffix: with users, dashboard and permissions pre-wired. Sign in with the admin account you bootstrap and go from there.
landing.terminal_helper: No account needed to run it locally. Sign-in is only for the hosted admin UI.
landing.cta_body: Open the admin UI to manage users, modules and background tasks.
landing.cta_sign_in: Sign in to the admin UI
